title: Business name, legal entity and brand

sections.skill: Tell a business name, a legal entity and a brand apart

questions.prompt: "Rivera Services LLC" operates as "Sparkle Clean" and uses a blue bubble logo. Which is the legal entity?

choices.text: Rivera Services LLC
The blue bubble logo used on the website
Sparkle Clean, the name printed on the van doors
The owner, Ms. Rivera, as a private person

questions.intro: Three different things are easy to mix up. The LEGAL ENTITY is the business as the law sees it, such as a sole proprietorship or an LLC (limited liability company), with its official name on state records if it was registered. The BUSINESS NAME customers see may be different, such as a trade name. The BRAND is how customers recognize and feel about the business: its logo, colors, voice and reputation. Example: "Rivera Services LLC" (entity) might operate as "Sparkle Clean" (name customers see) with a blue bubble logo (brand).
questions.feedback: The LLC on state records is the legal entity.
